Option A - Local Food Bank: cost $500, time commitment 2 hours/month, impact 200 families fed
Option B - National Cancer Research: cost $1000, time commitment 1 hour/month, impact Contributes to nationwide research efforts
Option C - Environmental Conservation: cost $750, time commitment 3 hours/month, impact Helps preserve 500 acres of wildlife habitat
Option D - Disaster Relief Fund: cost $2000, time commitment 1 hour/month, impact Provides aid to affected communities worldwide
What matters most to us when choosing a charity to support this quarter?
